  • Method Details

    • process

      Content process(Content original, String attribute, ContentProcessingOptions options) throws ContentProcessorException
      Return content based in a specific attribute of other content. This is necessary when the attribute IS NOT Content, but String, int, etc.
      Parameters:
      attribute - The name of the attribute to convert.
      options - Options applying to this conversion
      content - The content to convert.
      Returns:
      The conversion, once applied the options.
      Throws:
      ContentProcessorException

    • process

      Content process(Content original, ContentProcessingOptions options) throws ContentProcessorException
      It allows the conversion of anything to anything, so that it could be used also to convert from and to binary formats
      Parameters:
      original - The original content to convert.
      options - Options applying to this conversion
      Returns:
      Converted content.
      Throws:
      ContentProcessorException - If the content format is invalid or if the options are invalid.

    • getStructure

      Content getStructure(Content content, String attribute, int startLevel, ContentProcessingOptions options) throws ContentProcessorException
      Get a outputContentType dependent representation of the Content structure TODO: See a way of returning the actual structure, instead of a "cooked" one.
      Parameters:
      content - The original content for which we want to get the structure.
      attribute - From which attribute we get the body?
      startLevel - Ignore any levels (header levels, h1, h2, h3, etc) lower than this.
      options - Options applying to the way we are getting the information
      Returns:
      Content that will represent the structure of some other content
      Throws:
      ContentProcessorException - If the content format is invalid

    • configure

      void configure(ContentProcessorOptions options) throws ContentProcessorException
      Configure this instance of ContentProcessor with some options. There can be different instances of the same processor, processing different content types. This methods allow to specifically configure different processors with different parameters.
      Parameters:
      options - Options to apply to this processor.
      Throws:
      ContentProcessorException - If any option has an invalid value.

    • setProperty

      void setProperty(String name, String value) throws ContentProcessorException
      Set only one option of the content processor instance.
      Parameters:
      name - The name of the option
      value - The value of the option
      Throws:
      ContentProcessorException - If the name or the value are invalid.
